events.name: Shameless
events.description: Truths, lies and confessions emerge as time starts to run out for the five people trapped underground. Jamie panics that Karen will learn the truth about Gloria, Frank has a sobering revelation about what his life has become, while Ruby and Aidan grow increasingly angry with how the others perceive them. Meanwhile, back above ground, Karen desperately tries to work out where the missing five have gone - and as the clock ticks down, the residents of Chatsworth must decide whether to involve the authorities in the search

events.name: Benidorm
events.description: Sheron and Billy Dawson check in for some pool-side fun, bringing along their teenage son Rob, young daughter Jodie, and Grandad Eddie, to claim the sun-loungers left vacant following the Garveys' departure from the vacation spot. Meanwhile, resort boss Joyce Temple-Savage is desperate for new staff, and must choose between efficient, goody two-shoes Amber and the outrageously flirtatious Marcus, and Troy returns to Benidorm with Jacqueline and Kenneth to scatter Donald's ashes in the place he loved best. Julie Graham, Steve Edge and Bobby Knutt join the cast of the comedy drama set in the sun-kissed Solana resort

events.description: After more than a decade of unemployment, Frank Gallagher has finally been forced to get a job. However, as he prepares to rejoin the workforce, he is gripped by nightmares - will he be able to survive his new life? Meanwhile, Shane and Jackson's new bootlegging business looks set to be a disaster, until Billy offers unwanted assistance, and Patty decides to steal some pills after Avril refuses to increase her supply. Return of the Mancunian comedy drama, starring David Threlfall
